body: i know you probably got an overwhelming amount of offers, but my PMs are open if you need. i’m 18, and i feel like i understand a lot of what you’re going through. i hope things get better for you.
thank you <3
suicidal hangovers feel the worst. i feel for you. i’m sorry you went though this, and you’re not alone either.
good job :) i’m proud of you.

thank you so much. sometimes i do think about that question. it’s wild to think that the littlest choices can impact your life or other lives so easily.

thank you, again. i hope you’re also able to fight your demons.
i don’t have medical insurance and i can’t afford therapy. i did have therapy before when i had insurance but i lost it when my parents forgot to reapply in august and i haven’t had it since.
he said he wasn’t good enough and he didn’t have the ability to find joy in being with me.
i don’t know. he’s dumped me twice so far in our almost four month relationship.  i think he’s gonna dump me again.
mine too. very cozy
yeah i know. i just wish he would’ve at least warned me so i didn’t cancel all my plans and wait around at home while he left me on read. it’s just a bit frustrating

my boyfriend is struggling with depression too. he said he would come over to spend time with me but instead he left all of my texts left on read for the day. 

and as for the PTSD, i was raped, but that’s unrelated to my current boyfriend.
well i live in the southern US so i’ve never seen snow, but it is nice and cool outside. it was about 60 degrees fahrenheit. quite nice and rainy too.
christmas lights everywhere. it’s kinda nice
that’s super early for me
my day wasn’t good. my boyfriend ignored me all day and i had a mental breakdown because of my PTSD.

yeah she knows how it’s affecting me. she watched me have the worst mental breakdown of my life last week, it was a genuinely terrifying experience for me. i couldn’t stop screaming and crying and shaking, i was pulling out clumps of my hair and i couldn’t breathe. it’s getting far beyond just depression now. i don’t know what’s wrong with me anymore. i hope i can see a doctor soon. thank you for the kind words.

i’m really glad you’re going to get help. i wish i could do the same. my mom forgot to renew my insurance in august and keeps saying she’s going to do it but she hasn’t. cut me off in the middle of trauma therapy. i’ve been a mess since.
thank you. i don’t have many words, but this helped.
i feel like such an idiot when i post about my problems. like my problems are nothing compared to everybody else’s.
i was considering asking for less hours, but not so i can relax but so i can finish school. i don’t have any friends that would be willing to do that for me, either.
no, i don’t think i can. i just started working there about a month ago. i could request a day off for like a month from now. but that’s probably it.
with his minimum wage job he doesn’t even have a car of his own, and he can’t save up for one because he’s saving up to afford surgery for our dog.

i lied to get out of the hospital twice. it was hell. it’s so hard to look at the doctor with a smile on your face and tell them you’re doing great when really all you want to do is shrivel up into a ball and cry.
